candidates.description: This vector represents common German verb suffixes, roots, and inflectional endings.
This feature vector represents concepts related to travel, tourism, and hospitality.
These tokens are German adverbial modifiers used to express emphasis, degree, time, or modality within a sentence.
This vector is related to the German language, nationality, and related linguistic roots.
This feature vector activates on German locative and directional adverbs, particularly those formed with the prefix "da-" and references to the western direction or today.
This feature vector activates common German adverbs, nouns, and modifiers frequently used in general text.
This feature vector represents common German nominal suffixes and noun-forming morphological components.
This feature vector activates strongly on German modal and auxiliary verbs expressing necessity, possibility, or conditional mood.
This vector represents common German adjectival and nominal suffixes, morphological endings, and derivational morphemes.
This feature vector represents German conjunctions, transitional adverbs, and connective grammatical particles used to link clauses and ideas.
